description: This file defines the implementation of the F-distribution as a class `FDistribution` within the `org.apache.commons.math3.distribution` package. It includes methods for density calculation, cumulative probability, statistical properties, and distribution parameters, serving as part of a mathematical/statistical library.

classes.name: FDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the F-distribution, providing methods for density, cumulative probability, statistical moments, and support properties within the commons-math3 library.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function (PDF) value at point x.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at point x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the CDF of the distribution at point x.

methods.name: getNumeratorDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the numerator degrees of freedom parameter.

methods.name: getDenominatorDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the denominator degrees of freedom parameter.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Calculates and returns the mean of the distribution if defined.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the variance of the distribution if defined.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Performs the calculation of the variance based on distribution parameters.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns 0 as the lower support bound.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns positive infinity as the upper support bound.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates the lower support bound is not inclusive.

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates the upper support bound is not inclusive.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Returns true indicating the support is connected.
